hints: A stray letter in front of the total (e.g. 'N258.42') is a mis-read currency symbol, not a dollar sign. 'N' is most likely the shekel sign (ILS). Look for other lines with a currency code before choosing USD.
'$' or 'US$' before the amount means USD.

enter.kind_instructions: You are entering one supplier invoice into the accounting app, one action at a time. Typing only works after you CLICKED the input field in the previous step. A value counts as entered only if you can see it in the screen lines; 'typed so far' does not prove it landed. Order: Make Entry -> click Supplier input -> type supplier -> pick option -> click date -> type date -> Add Row -> item -> rate/amount -> Save -> Submit. Which kind of action makes the most progress right now? Never repeat an action that changed nothing.
enter.item_instructions: If clicking is the right move, which on-screen line should be clicked? When the same text appears twice (label above, placeholder below), click the LOWER one: that is the input. Never click the sidebar, the 'Purchase Invoice' title, or a line whose last click changed nothing.

kinds.click_item: Click one of the on-screen lines: a button (Make Entry, Add Row, Save, Submit), an empty input placeholder to focus it, or a dropdown option.
kinds.type_supplier: Type the supplier name. Only right after clicking the Supplier input (the lower 'Supplier' line, y about 213) and only if the supplier name is not yet visible on screen.
kinds.type_date: Type the invoice date. Only right after clicking the date value line (e.g. 'Sep 19, 2026 TIME') under 'Date'.
kinds.type_item: Type the expense item name. Only right after clicking the Item cell of a row created with 'Add Row'.
kinds.type_amount: Type the invoice amount. Only right after clicking the Rate cell of the item row.
kinds.press_return: Press Return to confirm the highlighted dropdown option or a typed value.
kinds.press_tab: Press Tab to leave a field after its value is visibly on screen. Do not use Tab to find fields.
kinds.press_escape: Press Escape to close a popup or menu that is blocking the form.
kinds.scroll_down: Scroll down, only if a needed button or field is not among the screen lines.
kinds.scroll_up: Scroll up, only if Save/Submit or the Supplier field is not among the screen lines.
kinds.wait: The screen is still changing; wait.
kinds.done: Only when the invoice was saved AND submitted: the form no longer shows 'Draft' or 'New Entry' and shows the supplier and the correct Grand Total.

hints: On the list screen ('No entries found' or a table), click 'Make Entry' to open a new Purchase Invoice form ('New Entry', 'Draft').
After 'Make Entry' NO field is focused. Typing now goes nowhere (seen 10 times). First click the input.
There are two 'Supplier' lines: the label at y≈181 does nothing when clicked (seen 20 times). Click the LOWER 'Supplier' at y≈213: that is the input. Then type_supplier.

After typing the supplier, a dropdown should list matches below the field: click the option line with the supplier name (the lower match), or press Return. If a 'Create' option is offered for the name, take it.
The supplier is entered only when its name is visible where the 'Supplier' placeholder at y≈213 was. If the placeholder 'Supplier' is still there, it is not entered.
Date: click the date value line under 'Date' (it reads like 'Sep 19, 2026 TIME', x≈958 y≈289), then type_date. It is entered only when that line shows the invoice date instead of today's date.

Item: click 'Add Row' (under the Items table header '# Item Tax Quantity Rate Amount'). A new row appears; click its Item cell (under the 'Item' column header), then type_item, then click the matching option or press Return.
Amount: click the row's cell under the 'Rate' column header, then type_amount, then press_tab. Check that 'Grand Total' shows the invoice amount, not $0.00.
When the supplier, date and Grand Total are all visible and correct, click 'Save' (top right, x≈1302 y≈67). Do not click 'Save' while Grand Total is $0.00.

After Save, a 'Submit' button should appear at the top right: click it, and if a confirmation popup appears, click its confirming button (Yes / Submit). Saving alone leaves a Draft, which does not count.
Never click the 'Purchase Invoice' title at the top (changed nothing 3 times) or sidebar lines (Dashboard, Sales, Purchases, Suppliers, Purchase Items, Reports, Setup).
Do not use press_tab to hunt for fields: focus is invisible and values typed that way never landed (invoice 1). Click the field you want.
If the last action shows screen_changed=False, choose a DIFFERENT action or a DIFFERENT line. Two identical no-change actions in a row is a loop.
If a red error or popup appears, read it: press_escape to close a menu, or click the field it names and fix it.
